title: Refund
description: A full or partial refund of a captured payment, with its own reference (FR-TXN-01, FR-TXN-14).

livemode.description: true for a live-mode key (sp_live_...), false for test mode (sp_test_...). The two modes never mix (v2).

status.description: reserved: amount held, not yet sent. submitted: sent to the simulator. unresolved: no answer; the amount stays reserved until reconciliation (FR-TXN-02). completed and failed are final. The URS states 'requested' and 'rejected' exist only in the dashboard: a rejected request is answered with an error and creates no refund object.

reason.description: Free text from the merchant. Must not contain card data.

failure_reason.description: Set only when status is failed.
